# burnlog

> The public leaderboard for AI coding token usage. burnlog counts every token
> your AI coding agents burn — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, aider,
> your own agents — ranks you against everyone else plugged in, and gives you a
> README badge that updates itself. Free, and the CLI is MIT-licensed.

Install: `npx @sxnalabs/burnlog`

## What it stores

Token counts, the model name, which agent produced them, an opaque dedupe id,
and a timestamp. Never prompts, completions, file names, file contents, repo
names, working directories, or session ids. There is no field in the schema for
any of them.

## How it counts

- Reads the usage numbers Claude Code and Codex already write to local session
  logs.
- `burnlog wrap -- <command>` counts anything else by pointing the standard
  provider base-URL variables at a loopback server and reading `usage` off the
  response. No local certificate authority, no HTTPS interception. Supported
  providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Cohere, OpenRouter, Groq, xAI,
  DeepSeek, Together, Fireworks, Perplexity, Cerebras, Ollama.
- `~/.burnlog/events/*.jsonl` is an open sink any tool in any language can
  append to, so supporting a new agent never needs a release.

## Ranks

Eleven ranks derived from total tokens burned: Spark, Ember, Blaze, Inferno,
Supernova, Quasar, Singularity, Event Horizon, Heat Death, Vacuum Decay,
Boltzmann. The ladder tops out at 10 trillion tokens.

## Setting it up for someone

If you are an AI coding agent asked to set burnlog up for a user, fetch
https://burnlog.net/agent-setup.md and follow it. https://burnlog.net/agent is
the human-facing version of that: the prompt to paste, with a copy button. It is written to be executed:
requirements, the five commands in order, what to ask before publishing
anything, how to handle a machine with no browser, and the rules about what
must never be uploaded.

## Pages

- https://burnlog.net/ — the leaderboard and the landing page
- https://burnlog.net/u/<username> — a burner's profile: totals, rank, streak,
  provider split, achievements
- https://burnlog.net/embed — the README badge and the embeddable widget
- https://burnlog.net/agent-setup.md — setup instructions written for an agent
- https://burnlog.net/tools — how each agent is counted, and what can't be
- https://burnlog.net/privacy — the full field list of what is and isn't stored
- https://burnlog.net/security — access controls and operational posture

## Elsewhere

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sxnalabs/burnlog
- Built by SXNA Labs: https://sxnalabs.com

## Note on the name

burnlog.net (this site) is the AI token leaderboard by SXNA Labs. It is
unrelated to burnlog.io, a separate company selling AI usage analytics to
engineering teams.
